proposed_fixes.title: Investigate VK240 remapped modifier release
proposed_fixes.root_cause: A VK240 sequence may lack a source-key release recognized by Keyboard Manager, leaving synthesized Ctrl down after physical release.
plan: Reproduce VK240-to-Ctrl on a Japanese 106/109 keyboard and capture source/remapped transitions.
Trace Keyboard Manager VK240 key-down and key-up paths to determine whether release is absent, translated, or discarded.
If confirmed, add narrow state cleanup or unsupported-key handling and regression coverage for matching and absent releases.
verification: Repeat repro and confirm Ctrl is released after source key is lifted.
Run focused remap tests for matching and missing release events.
